_comment: Tiered thresholds. Each metric's 'tier_X' field is the minimum value to enter that tier. Tier escalates to the max of any metric's tier.

cpu_util_pct._comment: CPU is NOT the crash signal (all 0x116 BSODs had GPU=0%; the real crash is the idle GPU TDR, handled by gpu-keepalive). 2026-06-01: capped CPU at 'yellow' (tier_orange/red/critical unreachable) so routine CPU spikes (opening a browser, codex, compiles) no longer trigger orange suspend mitigations — which were freezing the browser on launch. Yellow only throttles (priority), never suspends.

_sustain_seconds._comment: How many consecutive seconds a metric must hold a tier before escalation triggers. Prevents transient spikes.

_hysteresis_seconds._comment: How many consecutive seconds at lower tier before de-escalation and mitigation rollback.
